# Bellver Affiliates by MTG

> An independent, plain-words guide to the Bellver Card, a crypto-funded payment card (fund it with USDT or USDC, spend in any currency), written by MTG (Musa The Giant), a Bellver affiliate. It covers how the card works, every price and fee, the rewards program (one-time referral commissions and the 2x2 matrix monthly rewards with the $100 a month rule), step-by-step video tutorials and short explainer videos. It is not the official Bellver website.

Key facts (from Bellver's official price list and compensation plan, version 08/2026, and Bellver's October 2026 update):

- Four card levels, one-time price: Basic $99, Premium $270, Business $490, Gold $990. No monthly or annual fee listed.
- Fees: 3.9% card top-up fee (taken out of the amount loaded: load $100 and $96.10 reaches the card), 1.75% per transaction, 2% ATM withdrawal.
- Physical card: Visa (ATM cash, shipping $85 Europe, $149 rest of world). Virtual card: Mastercard, usable the same day.
- Funds sit in the cardholder's own non-custodial Fireblocks wallet, protected by their private key.
- Referral commissions (one-time): $10 Basic, $100 Premium, $200 Business, $400 Gold; Special Edition $150, $300, $500.
- Monthly rewards: 0.1% of completed top-ups in the cardholder's 2x2 matrix, for those holding Premium or higher with two direct Premium+ referrals, who load at least $100 onto their own card that month. Missing it three months in a row loses the matrix position. Rewards are never guaranteed.

Order link used on this site (MTG's referral link): https://app.bellvercards.com?ref=mtg
